package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package is described in this report. The content discusses NIST's Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) and general secure software development practices, including the need to check for backdoors and malicious content in software, but does not provide details of any particular malicious code or package.

behavioral_signatures: Unusual or unauthorized code changes in software supply chain
Presence of undocumented or hidden backdoors
Unexpected network communications from build or deployment scripts
file_indicators: Unexplained changes in source code repositories
Unexpected dependencies or binaries in software bills of materials (SBOMs)
network_indicators: Outbound connections to unknown or suspicious domains during build or install processes
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Implement continuous code review and automated scanning for backdoors and malicious content. Maintain and monitor SBOMs for unexpected changes or dependencies. Monitor build and deployment environments for unauthorized network activity or file modifications.
